name: Svelte Animation Components
summary: Animated Svelte 5 component library: free ports of Magic UI, Aceternity UI and Luxe components, installable via CLI.
description: An open-source library of animated Svelte 5 components built with Tailwind CSS and Framer Motion, ported from Magic UI, Aceternity UI, Luxe and Indie UI. It covers docks, dropdown menus, marquees, animated backgrounds, shiny text, animated-border buttons, badges, inputs and cards, with examples like a dynamic island effect, shifting dropdown and encrypt button. SaaS and developer portfolio templates are also included.
contains: ports of Magic UI, Aceternity UI, Luxe and Indie UI components
components include dock menu, marquee, animated beam, meteors, shiny text, animated button borders
examples: dynamic island effect, shifting dropdown, link hover effects, slide tab, encrypt button
install via CLI; full TypeScript; light/dark support
SaaS landing page template (Svelte 5, Tailwind CSS v4, shadcn-svelte) and a free developer portfolio template
